text:
jamal: Heads up — forecasts are undershooting GPU hours for APAC this week. Looks like ingestion volume from asia-east is ~40% lower vs expected. Any ideas?

mira: Is that from the raw usage logs or the aggregated rollups?

jamal: Raw. Our kafka consumer shows fewer events. Partition offsets around 0 for two partitions since 03:12 UTC. No recent consumer errors in logs.

kevin: Could be sample-rate toggle got flipped during deploy. I pushed a change last night to reduce sampling for noisy tenants. @jamal can you paste consumer config?

jamal: Sure — current config pulled from cluster:
```
kafka.consumer.sample_rate=0.3
kafka.consumer.group=ingest-prod
kafka.consumer.max.poll.records=500
```

ben: If sample_rate is 0.3 that's ~70% drop — matches what you're seeing. But where'd the config roll out? Deployment was global; we have region overrides in k8s configmap. Maybe asia-east didn't get the override and defaulted. :thinking: 

jamal: Checked configmaps — asia-east override was missing. CI failed to apply due to kube RBAC flake. There's also a failed backfill job: backfill-2026-03-06 ID: bf-8742

ingest-bot: Job bf-8742 failed: EgressError copying logs -> s3://redwood-forecasting-backups/asia-east/bf-8742. Error: ENETUNREACH

mira: ENETUNREACH suggests network route/NAT gateway issue. Are we hitting regional NAT SNAT limits? We saw NAT gateway reuse issues last month.

kevin: Also be careful: copying 7 days of raw logs across regions will incur ~12TB egress (~$1200). Estimate before we copy. Maybe we should re-run ingestion in-region instead of cross-region transfer.

sarah: Action plan: (1) re-run backfill in-region (re-run bf-8742 in asia-east), (2) temporarily set sample_rate=1.0 for last 48h to capture missing events, (3) add dashboard panel + alert for ingest_drop_rate by region. I'll take #3. :white_check_mark:

ben: PromQL for ingest_drop_rate panel: 
sum by(region) (rate(kafka_consumer_dropped_events_total[5m])) / sum by(region) (rate(kafka_consumer_received_total[5m]))

mira: Also add metric for consumer_lag_seconds by region and a note to adjust autoscaling policy for asia-east consumers. I'll open an infra ticket.

jamal: I'll re-run bf-8742 in asia-east once RBAC fix merged. Copying logs only if re-run fails. ETA ~2h.

sarah: Ok added dashboard panel, alert threshold at 0.05 drop rate. Created PR: #5123. :mag:

kevin: We should also add a column to the forecasting pipeline output that tags data source confidence (sample_rate, backfill_applied) so model knows to weight or ignore low-confidence days.

ben: Agreed — makes downstream forecast merge logic cleaner. Filing spec in #data-eng.

jamal: Thanks all. Will post status update when backfill done. :thumbsup:
